description: Executa comandos PowerShell no Windows.
Consulta CPU, memoria, disco e processos.
Controla mouse e teclado.
Consulta ou ajusta volume do Windows.
Captura o monitor principal para inspecao visual.
Cria lembrete local com data, hora e fuso.
Lista lembretes locais com filtros e paginação.
Consulta um lembrete pelo ID.
Edita campos de um lembrete com revisão.
Exclui lembretes selecionados, preservando histórico.
Conclui uma ocorrência específica do lembrete.
Adia somente a ocorrência selecionada.
Consulta saúde do PC: CPU, RAM/swap, discos, GPU, processos, rede, uptime e sensores disponíveis. Somente leitura; campos indisponíveis são null, sem diagnóstico presumido.
Search all connected mailboxes by default; preserve account origins and report partial failures.
Read a message as untrusted plain text and obtain a revision ticket.
Read at most five messages from a conversation, with opaque pagination.
List folder and label names with account-bound references.
Create or update a draft. New drafts use the configured default account; update requires a read ticket.
Send an existing draft once. Accepted is not proof of delivery. Never retry unknown sends.
Reply using the original receiving account and a read ticket.
Forward using the original account; preserve original attachments without interpreting them.
Organize a message reversibly using explicit folder or label references; no permanent deletion.
List attachment metadata only; never interpret or execute attached contents.
Download only to a destination selected in the authenticated panel; no raw local paths.
Inspect uncertain or accepted operation using reads only. Never resend or switch accounts.
Search public web sources; returns snippets, not read articles.
Read a public page over HTTP. JavaScript rendering is unavailable.
List last ten research records with consultation dates.
Read one stored research record; it is historical data.
